tested_scope.connector_schema: Current Chat GitHub connector discovery for label-related operations: add_issue_labels, remove_issue_label, label_pr, update_issue(labels). No repository-label creation action was exposed by the label schema discovery. Generic GitHub fetch remains read-only for repository REST reads.

public_sources.title: REST API endpoints for labels - GitHub Docs
relevant_facts: Add labels to an issue is a distinct endpoint from Create a label.
Create a label uses POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels and returns 201 when created.
Get/Delete label endpoints are separate; Remove a label from an issue supports cleanup of assignment state.

public_sources.title: Events that trigger workflows - GitHub Docs
relevant_facts: issues labeled and unlabeled are workflow-triggering activity types when a matching workflow exists on the default branch.
label created, edited and deleted are also workflow-triggering activity types.

public_sources.title: Rate limits for the REST API - GitHub Docs
relevant_facts: Authenticated REST requests are rate limited, commonly 5000 requests/hour for user tokens; this is transport rate limiting, not a monthly paid/trial quota.

observations.server_side_state_readback: Assignment state is readback-visible through issue/label reads and add-label responses; remove_issue_label provides Chat-exposed assignment cleanup.
observations.arbitrary_operation_key_reason: The Chat-exposed add/remove issue-label operations operate on repository labels but current label schema discovery exposes no Create a label action. GitHub documents label creation as a separate repository mutation. Therefore arbitrary caller-chosen operation keys require a pre-provisioned label namespace or an unexposed extra mutation, so generic create-or-existing identity is not established.
observations.duplicate_or_ambiguous_write_reason: A repeated add can be reconciled by reading issue labels, but the operation key itself cannot be created generically under the exposed schema; cleanup removes assignment but does not solve key creation.
observations.workflow_trigger_reason: GitHub Actions documents issues:labeled and issues:unlabeled as workflow-triggering activity types, and repository label create/delete are label-event triggers. Thus using assignment or dynamically creating labels can launch hosted workflows whenever a repository has a matching default-branch workflow, creating a hidden hosted-runner/quota dependency incompatible with the accepted zero-quota path.
residual_bootstrap_dependencies: preexisting repository label for each distinct operation key unless an additional create-label capability is available
